% ---- \bar from an OT1 font in every math version: the class sets the operators
% font of the caption math version to T1 Formata, where slot "16 is not a macron
\DeclareSymbolFont{baraccent}{OT1}{cmr}{m}{n}
\DeclareMathAccent{\bar}{\mathalpha}{baraccent}{"16}
\newcommand{\Dbar}{\ensuremath{\bar{D}}}
